title: Session navigation
description: Measure only trusted session navigation. First visits and returns to previously visited sessions are plotted across history size with the workspace panel closed. A separate trend measures returns with an already-open workspace panel across identical light, moderate, and heavy seeded panel states.

metrics.description: One trusted session-row activation to the destination session's correct painted and input-ready endpoint; when the panel is already open, both session and seeded panel state must be ready.
For the already-open-panel trend, exact-interval renderer task, script, style-recalculation, layout, frame, and long-animation-frame evidence.
